newsitem.title: EGYPT: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Egypt economic press - Jan 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian economic press this week. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Six companies have now taken advantage of the central share depositary facility offered by Misr Clearing Company. The last of the six to do was Telemisr/Arab Radio Transistor and Electronics Supplies.

- The government's privatisation committee has decided to offer 10 percent of the shares in Alexandria Container Handling and Damietta Container Handling by auction to a strategic investment. The investors may be given the right to manage the compaiesy, providing experience to develop them.
- Al-Ahram Beverages, also known as Pyramids Breweries, made unaudited pre-tax profits of 34.3 million pounds ($10 million) in the five months ending November. (No comparative figure was given).
- North Cairo Flour Mills made net after-tax profits of 61.4 million pounds in the six-month period July-December 1996, against 61.5 million in the same period of the previous year.

- Misr Free Shops made pre-tax unaudited profits of 7.8 million pounds in the five months up to the end of November 1996, which suggest that profits for 1996/7, which ends on June 30, will be 15 million.

- Egyptian Starch and Glucose made net pre-tax profits of 14.9 million pounds (unaudited) in the five months up to the end of November 1996, against 15.1 million in the same period of the previous financial year. The firm cut the prices of its products by an average of 3.84 percent in September.
- Egyptian Electro Cables made net pre-tax unaudited profits of 11 million pounds in the five months up to the end of November 1996. (No comparative figure was given.)

- Kafr el-Zayat Pesticides and Chemicals made a profit of 7.869 million pounds, before tax and allocations, in the first five months of 1996/7, against 2.479 million in the same period of the previous financial year.
